blocks.title: Session controls: slash command list, model, effort, mode, always allow, status line
Composer: slash and @ popup, file index, keyboard, input history and draft
Questions tool: mouse-first answering, Other, decline

consultations.question: Are the functional goals and problems understood correctly, and what should 'nicely integrated' mean for the questions tool?
consultations.answer: Scope is the ticket (slash commands, @ references, model, mode, questions tool) plus effort level, input history and draft, status line and 'always allow'. Plan approval is not included. The questions tool must be answerable with the mouse.

consultations.question: Is the cut into three theme blocks right: session controls, composer, questions tool?
options: Merge session controls and composer into one block

consultations.question: Is knowledge.md correct, and may I commit and push it to the ticket repo and link it on issue #11?
consultations.answer: Correct, commit, push and link (developer: 'Dann mal los mit Schritt 6')

consultations.question: Which approach for b1: how the registry reaches the SDK controls, who owns the mode semantics, and where always allow is enforced?
options: Widen RunQuery with a Pick of Query, the hook follows the SDK mode after a spike, always allow via SDK suggestions
consultations.answer: Widen RunQuery with a Pick of Query (option 1). The SDK owns the mode semantics (variant A): the always-ask hook only asks in default mode, which supersedes ADR 0006. Always allow via the SDK suggestions as updatedPermissions with destination session, honouring suppressAlwaysAllowRule and defaultToNo. Effort via applyFlagSettings, tracked on the server. Orient on the terminal.

consultations.question: Which approach for b3: hybrid answer flow (one card for a single question, tabs with a review step for several), decline as deny with an optional message, Other as the answer text, previews kept as plain text?
options: Hybrid (option C) with the sub-decisions as recommended
Wizard for every question set (option B)
consultations.answer: Hybrid (option C): one card with direct send for a single question, tabs with a review step for several. Decline is deny with an optional message and no interrupt. Other is the answer text. No annotations. Previews stay plain text, shown for the focused option. The previewFormat default is checked on a real request in step 7.

consultations.question: Which approach for b2: command list as a live event pushed on attach, git-based file index with refresh on open and a short TTL, a custom listbox that keeps focus in the textarea, history and draft in the browser, plain @path text. And should the popup highlight no row by default, as the terminal does?
options: As recommended, no default highlight (terminal parity)
As recommended, first row highlighted by default
consultations.answer: As recommended, and no row highlighted by default, so Enter sends the text as typed and Tab takes the top match.

consultations.question: Are the LikeC4 change, the frozen contracts and the two ADRs right for b1? Everything after this is implemented strictly against them.
options: The chat seam is too close: merge b1 and b2
consultations.answer: Freeze as they stand, including the chat seam and the shared not_held result.

consultations.question: The auto mode is now offered, which changes the frozen SessionMode. Is the reopened contract right, with auto second in the ring and coloured like the other modes that let work happen unasked?
options: Put auto somewhere else in the ring
consultations.answer: Freeze again as it stands, with auto second in the ring.

consultations.question: Are the LikeC4 change, the three frozen contracts and the two ADRs right for b2?
ComposerProperties was frozen without what the composer needs to reach. Should it take the command list and the draft book as properties?
options: Take both as properties, as proposed
Let the composer make its own draft book and take only the commands
consultations.answer: Take both the commands and the draft book as properties, as proposed.

jump_log.reason: The auto mode was left out of SessionMode by ADR 0020 and the developer wants it offered, which changes a frozen wire type.
ComposerProperties was frozen without the commands the slash completion reads and without the draft book, so the composer could not reach what the LikeC4 model already says it depends on.
